messages.癖のないスキルで扱いやすい初期人格。状態異常は単独ではほとんど活きず、本領は編成: An easy-to-use starting Identity with straightforward skills. His status effects do little alone; his main role is often on the bench, where Gene Code G-0 provides healing every turn.
messages.サポートパッシブ「因子コードG-0」(憂鬱×3・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 編成中: **Support passive — Gene Code G-0 (3 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in the team but not participating in battle, heals 5 HP to the 1 ally with the lowest current HP at Combat Start. It can trigger every turn without spending resources, so it works well in dungeons with many turns, and it is this Identity's centerpiece.
messages.バトルパッシブ「強制生存」(憂鬱×3・保有): 戦闘参加中、戦闘開始時に自分の体: **Combat passive — Forced Survival (3 Gloom Owned)**: While participating in battle, he heals 5 of his own HP at Combat Start.
messages.S3「切り刻む」: 対象に破裂があれば各コインのダメージ量+10%。Ⅱコインの表: **S3 — Chop Up**: Each Coin deals +10% damage if the target has Rupture. On Coin Ⅱ Heads Hit, he heals HP equal to 30% of the damage dealt.
messages.破裂と貫通脆弱: S1「斬る」は表面的中時に破裂2(同期化段階が上がると4)を付: **Rupture and Pierce Fragility**: S1 Swipe inflicts 2 Rupture on Heads Hit (4 at higher Uptie) but does not increase Rupture Count. S2 Jag adds +1 Rupture Count with Coin Ⅰ and inflicts 2 Rupture and 1 Pierce Fragility on Heads Hit. On his own, Rupture Count runs short and tends to disappear before S3.
messages.罪悪属性: S1が憂鬱、S2が暴食、S3が怠惰。S2・S3でE.G.O《まやかし: **Sin affinities**: S1 is Gloom, S2 Gluttony, and S3 Sloth. S2 and S3 cover the resources for the E.G.O Legerdemain.
messages.鏡ダンジョンなど長丁場では、編成に入れたまま戦闘不参加にして「因子コードG-0」: In long runs such as the Mirror Dungeon, keeping him in the team but out of battle as a healer through Gene Code G-0 is effective. It heals the lowest-HP ally first, so note that it can break the conditions of Identities that rely on "below X% HP." When deploying him, treat S1's and S2's Rupture as a bonus, deal damage with his Pierce S2 and S3, and hold out with S3's Coin Ⅱ healing and Forced Survival.
